la Trinitat Vella — Barcelona, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

No evidence of daytime tourist-targeted crime was found for this barri. Real press does show isolated violent incidents: a man arrested for stabbing another man in the street (Sept 2025) and a knife attack among family members inside a home (July 2026, domestic in nature). In 2020, residents formed vigilante street patrols after a spate of robberies/intimidation blamed on young people living in occupied housing, leading to a confrontation with police. These are genuine but sparse, mostly interpersonal/localized incidents. Sources checked: cronicaglobal.elespanol.com, Jun 2020; metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, Sept 2025 / Jul 2026.
